clauses: This physician, biologist, and university teacher made monumental contributions to the field of biochemistry.

In recognition of their outstanding achievements, this scientist was awarded the Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine, the Albert Lasker Award for Basic Medical Research, the Canada Gairdner International Award, and the Louisa Gross Horwitz Prize.
However, this scientist was never awarded the Wolf Prize in Medicine and did not receive their education at the University of Buenos Aires.
